status: Bulk shared deadline/estimate pickers and personal estimates implemented; scoped Core/build and installed phone/tablet acceptance passed. Wider rank 6/Px remains open.

implementation.shared: Opening-time full-row/access admission; Set/Clear and field-only values; complete frozen review; Edit choice retains input; Cancel saves nothing; existing one-group Save and linked Undo.

implementation.bounds: ASCII integer estimates 1 through 10080; clear ignores stale invalid text; deadline day validation. Shared 1–100 distinct tasks, personal existing 1–1000 bound.
implementation.presentation: Visible Minutes label, presets, existing deadline/estimate and planned-date context; short Review changes title avoids the observed phone header truncation.
implementation.ownership: Each project registers and compiles its own source; no cross-repository build dependency.

native.scope: Installed synthetic isolated iOS host, real Store/private cache with intercepted HTTP. No live hosted/Auth/Keychain acceptance.

diagnostics: Initial builds failed when a view read Store private workspaceCacheReadable; validation moved inside Store. Corrected final builds pass.

After label/alignment polish, deleting or selecting the default estimate through automated system menu actions could enter 025 instead of 0. Native assertions caught this; no product validation failure was hidden.

Final test inserts oversized digits at any caret position, asserts their presence and refusal, then uses a preset. Zero and all numeric bounds are separately covered by Core; earlier native runs also exercised zero.

The phone typing collector PID 7504 and iPad final collector PID 8155 remained alive after failed suites ended. Exact owned commands were verified and those collectors terminated with SIGTERM (143). Logs are retained; neither run is claimed green.
iPad title run completed with 2 passing shared cases and the same typing diagnostic failure (exit 65). Final accepted suites supersede it.
An earlier screenshot showed a truncated long review title; final source uses Review changes and the final native test asserts that navigation title.
